effects.description: (3 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Increases the bonuses and penalties of your Vampire Stage, depending on how far you've progressed.

Stage 1/2/3/4

1%/2%/4%/6% additional Flame Damage Taken.
1%/2%/4%/6% increased Regular Ability cost.
5%/10%/15%/20% reduced Vampire Ability cost.
